node.statement: Using W.K2>=K_2^0, W.e_s2<=e_s2^0, and K_2^0=max{1,e_s2^0/e_env^0}, the same upper bound gives epsilon<=W.e_s2/W.K2<=e_s2^0/K_2^0<=e_env^0. Multiplying W.K2>=1, W.K2>=W.L, and W.K2>=W.c0_cb*W.L by epsilon>=0 gives respectively epsilon<=t_2, W.L*epsilon<=t_2, and W.c0_cb*W.L*epsilon<=t_2.
